acceptance: A latest nonterminal return with structured source_debt.status=OPEN is excluded from ordinary time-only recovery unless newer recovery_basis evidence is present.
New durable evidence can reopen a bounded recovery path without weakening SOURCE_DEBT truth.
Regression preserves ordinary replaceable recovery for jobs without evidence-bound SOURCE_DEBT.
